faces.transcription: Find card 51 from the Operations deck and place it faceup in the Operations area.
faces.flavor: "All right team, I went over your responses and have an initial evaluation. Best I can figure is you're a little uncertain. It takes a while for new agents to find their footing, and this is more common than you'd think. So, we're gonna give you a little nudge, something to make sure you learn to work in the field, away from the nest."
